verdict.rationale: The evidence shows New Relic alerting: defining thresholds, choosing who is notified, and routing issues to teams via notifications. That is an adjacent alert-routing capability, not incident declaration with timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies. Incident management is a fair axis for an observability platform, but this pack has no evidence that New Relic ships it.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
